+    initial = s.objects()
+    bottle_h = initial["mustard_bottle"]["size"][2]
+    box_bounds = np.asarray(initial["raisin_box"]["bounds"], dtype=float)
+    box_xy = box_bounds[:, :2].mean(axis=0)
+    box_top = float(box_bounds[1, 2])
+    bottle_xy = np.asarray(initial["mustard_bottle"]["position"][:2], dtype=float)
+    grasp_yaws = [0.0, float(p["yaw_for_closing_dir"]([1.0, 0.0]))]
+    place_compressions = [0.003, 0.008, 0.0]
+    best_actions = None
+
+    for attempt, (yaw, compression) in enumerate(
+        ( (yaw, z) for yaw in grasp_yaws for z in place_compressions ), start=1
+    ):
+        if attempt > 1:
+            s.reset()
+        q = np.asarray(p["top_down_quat"](yaw), dtype=float)
+        grasp_z = 0.050
+        approach_z = 0.245
+        s.record_start()
+        try:
+            p["open_gripper"](steps=15)
+            p["move_ee"]([bottle_xy[0], bottle_xy[1], approach_z], q, speed=0.20, settle=3)
+            p["move_ee"]([bottle_xy[0], bottle_xy[1], grasp_z], q, speed=0.12, settle=3)
+            p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
+            p["move_ee"]([bottle_xy[0], bottle_xy[1], 0.245], q, speed=0.16, settle=8)
+            p["hold"](8)
+
+            bottle_pos = np.asarray(p["get_object_pose"]("mustard_bottle")[0], dtype=float)
+            ee_pos = np.asarray(s.ee_pose()[0], dtype=float)
+            lifted = bottle_pos[2] - float(initial["mustard_bottle"]["position"][2])

+            if lifted < 0.075:
+                best_actions = s.record_stop()
+                print(f"attempt {attempt}: grasp missed; resetting", flush=True)

+
+            # Keep the measured rigid grasp offset so placement accounts for the actual fingertip pose.
+            grasp_offset = bottle_pos - ee_pos
+            target_bottle = np.array([
